Shielded is an Engineering Blueprint for Frame Shift Drives that improves integrity and thermal behaviour, trading maximum range focus for durability.

{{#invoke:EngineeringBlueprints|infobox|fsd_shielded}}

== What It Does ==
Shielded is a durability-oriented Frame Shift Drive Blueprint. It is a niche alternative when module survivability and heat behaviour matter more than maximum jump range.
